scripts.check: node --check background.js && node --check experiment/implementation.js && npm test && node tests/static-check.mjs
scripts.setup: git config core.hooksPath .githooks && chmod +x .githooks/pre-commit && echo "Git hooks installed: manifest.json now auto-syncs to package.json on commit."
scripts.package: node scripts/sync-manifest-version.mjs && rm -f dist/reopen-drafts.xpi && mkdir -p dist && zip -q -r dist/reopen-drafts.xpi manifest.json background.js session-state.js popup.html toolbar.js toolbar-hidden.html toolbar-hidden.js options.html ui.js ask.html ask.js ui.css assets experiment _locales README.md LICENSE NOTICE docs/issues.md
